thread:
alex: Heads-up — partner asked for clarified billing & supply transparency before we sign the Q3 reserve. key asks: SKU-level eviction curve, committed vs flexible billing windows, and a sample meter dump for one week. can we collect?

maria: We need the CSV schema from them. request these columns: per-SKU preempt_rate(%), average_eviction_duration(s), region_tag, min_commit_hours, billing_granularity_min, late_charge_policy. also ask for note on listing fees.

alex: +1. can someone draft an email template? cc @jamie for CSV ingest shape.

jamie: I'll sketch the mapping. Prefer this header so our parser is deterministic:

```
sku,region,min_commit_hours,max_burst_slots,preempt_rate_pct,avg_reclaim_secs,billing_granularity_minutes,overage_rate_per_hour,early_termination_credit_pct
```
I'll add sample rows after we get the vendor file.

hao: Important: ask them to provide timestamped meter samples (UTC) so we can simulate clock skew and billing alignment. without timestamps our cost model misattributes cross-region bursts.

maria: Also ask about marketplace listing fee & rebate timing — some vendors bill listing monthly pro-rata which breaks our invoice rollups. want exact invoice line item names.

sam-ops: From infra side, we need an example of their SKU lifecycle events via webhook (spin_up, preempt_notice, graceful_eviction, forced_eviction). JSON payload example pls — we want keys: `event`, `sku`, `instance_id`, `timestamp`, `reason`.

partner-bot: Vendor upload available: https://s3.company/vendorX/sample_supply_week1.csv (permissions: partners/redwood-read). uploaded 2411122400.

alex: Received. team, can we run a quick sim by EOD to surface any delta vs current assumptions? if not, at least validate schema and flag mismatches.

jamie: On it. started ingest. initial note: `avg_reclaim_secs` looks like milliseconds in this file — will normalize to seconds and document transformation.

maria: also flag: their draft contract has a "commit cliff" clause — 30% penalty if min_commit_hours not achieved within first 60 days. need legal to weigh in. @sam-ops FYI.

sam-ops: noted. engaging legal. Also will add a validation job to flag missing `region` or `region_tag` rows during ingest.

alex: plan: jamie to normalize and run sim, maria to follow up on listing fee timing, sam-ops to add validation + webhook example request, hao to run clock-skew sim. sync tomorrow 10:30. :calendar:
